k:預.mnemonic: You place on the head (頂) of the bank clerk your dog's muzzle (マ), because you lack (欠) a safer spot for it. He will mind it until you come back. Deposit (custody, leave with, entrust to).
k:預.hint: Muzzle left on the clerk's head.

k:幻.mnemonic: A tiny (幺) thread of mist with a hook curling beside it. It is so tiny and wispy that when you reach out to catch it on the hook, nothing is there. Phantasm (vision, dream, illusion).

k:芳.mnemonic: Flowers (艹) send their scent out in every direction (方). Whichever direction you turn your nose, the garden reaches it. Perfume (balmy, favorable, fragrant).

k:灰.mnemonic: A fire (火) lit under an overhang (厂). By morning the fire is out, and all that is left under the rock is a soft grey heap. Ashes (puckery juice, cremate).

k:征.mnemonic: The army takes a stroll (彳) through the rebel province to correct (正) it. By the time the boots have marched through, everyone is obedient again. Subjugate (attack the rebellious, collect taxes).
k:征.hint: A march that sets things straight.

k:狙.mnemonic: A hound (犭) with its eye (目) fixed on a rabbit: frozen, one paw lifted, nose pointing straight at the target. Aim at (sight, shadow, stalk).
k:狙.hint: Hound's eye locked on a rabbit.

k:抵.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) spread flat against a whole clan (氏): one hand held up to the crowd at the gate, refusing to let it through. Resist (reach, touch).

k:脇.mnemonic: After a month (月) of lifting with power (力), power, and more power, three times a day, the place that sweats most is the hollow under your arm. Armpit (the other way, another place, flank).

k:魂.mnemonic: A person is made of two (二) things. When the body is gone, the ghost (鬼) is the second one, the part that floats on like a cloud. Soul (spirit, energy, mood).

k:賢.mnemonic: The retainer (臣) counts the lord's shellfish (貝) money and also (又) keeps a firm hand on it. He was given the treasury because he is the sharpest mind at court. Intelligent (wise, wisdom, cleverness).
k:賢.hint: The retainer trusted with the treasury.

k:鑑.mnemonic: One perfect piece of gold (金) is kept under glass for the assayer to oversee (監). Every new nugget is held up against this model one. Specimen (take warning from, learn from).

k:尻.mnemonic: Nine (九) hours on a hard bench at the parade, sitting on a folded flag (尸) as a cushion. The flag knows exactly which part of you is sore. Buttocks (hips, butt, rear).
k:尻.hint: Nine hours sitting on a flag.

k:峰.mnemonic: Trudge (夂) up the mountain (山) until there is nothing left to trudge up, then plant your tufted pole in the top. Summit (peak).
k:峰.hint: Pole planted where the climb ends.

k:揚.mnemonic: At dawn (旦), fingers (扌) haul on the rope and the streamers (勿) climb the pole into the wind. Hoist (fry, raise, elevate).

k:搬.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) lift crates off the carrier (般) one after another and pass them down the line, hand to hand, without stopping. Conveyor (carry, transport, hold).

k:羅.mnemonic: A net (罒) woven from the finest fiber (維), so thin that you can see straight through it. A net that is really a cloth. Gauze (thin silk, Rome, arrange).

k:促.mnemonic: The leader (亻) nudges you with his leg (足): a tap of the boot on your heel to get you moving faster. Stimulate (urge, press, demand).

k:沙.mnemonic: The tsunami (氵) pulls back to sea, and only a few (少) tiny grains are left behind in your shoes. Grit (sand).

k:唐.mnemonic: Under the palace canopy (广), a servant with a broom (ヨ) sweeps a great map of Asia (亜) laid into the floor. This is the court of the dynasty that ruled its heart. T'ang (China, foreign).

k:獣.mnemonic: Something with a sparkle (⺌) in its eyes is crouching in the rice field (田) at night. The dog (犬) barks at it and backs away: it is wilder than any dog. Beast (animal).

k:輩.mnemonic: A banner against injustice (非) is tied to the roof of a car (車), and the workers ride to the protest together, squeezed shoulder to shoulder. Comrade (fellow, people, companions).

k:鉱.mnemonic: Gold (金) spread wide (広) through the rock: not a nugget yet, just a broad glittering seam waiting to be dug out. Mineral (ore).

k:剛.mnemonic: A knife (刂) is stabbed into a knoll (岡). The blade bends double and the knoll does not even notice. Sturdy (strength, power, force).

k:涯.mnemonic: Under its own pressure (圧) the tsunami (氵) draws all the way back to the line where sea meets sky, the far edge of everything. Horizon (shore, limit, bound).
k:涯.hint: Sea pulled back to the edge.

k:軌.mnemonic: A car (車) drives the same muddy lane nine (九) times, and its wheels cut two deep grooves that every later car must follow. Rut (wheel, track, model).

k:陥.mnemonic: An empty cradle (勹) is set on top of a mound (阝). The mound begins to bend (曲) in the middle, then gives way, and the cradle drops into the hole. Collapse (fall into, cave in, slide into).
k:陥.hint: The mound sags and gives way.

k:邪.mnemonic: A tusk (牙) hangs over the gate of the borough (阝): the poacher's boast, and a warning about who runs this place. Wicked (injustice, wrong).

k:貢.mnemonic: Shellfish (貝) money is carried to the king's construction (工) site. Every village must send its share to pay for his new palace. Tribute (support, finance).

k:駄.mnemonic: A horse (馬) loaded with fat (太) sacks, sagging in the middle and barely able to put one hoof in front of the other. Burdensome (pack horse, horse load, trivial).

k:穂.mnemonic: A stalk of grain (禾) bows its heavy head as if to think (思), with ten (十) fat kernels packed at the tip. Ear of grain (head of grain, ear, head).
